readings.subsection: Confidence in the Face of Adversity
readings.title: The Light and Deliverance
readings.subtitle: A Song of Fearless Trust
readings.text:
[Psalm 27:1] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is my light and my deliverance; Whom should I fear? <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is the refuge of my life; Whom should I dread?
[2] When evil-doers come against me To eat up <dn>את</dn> my flesh, My adversaries and my enemies, They shall stumble and fall.
[3] Though an army encamps against me, My heart does not fear; Though battle comes up against me, Even then I would be trusting.
[4] One matter I asked of <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – <dn>את</dn> this I seek: To dwell in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> All the days of my life, To see the pleasantness of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And to inquire in <dn>His</dn> Hěḵal.
[5] For in the day of evil <dn>He</dn> hides me in <dn>His</dn> booth; In the covering of <dn>His</dn> Tent <dn>He</dn> hides me; On a rock <dn>He</dn> raises me up.
[6] And now my head is lifted up above my enemies all around me; And I slaughter in <dn>His</dn> Tent with slaughters of sounding; I sing, yes, I sing praises to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.subsection: Confidence in the Face of Adversity
readings.title: Seeking the Face of the Creator
readings.subtitle: A Plea for Guidance and Strength
readings.text:
[7] Hear, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, when I cry with my voice! And show me favour, and answer me.
[8] To my heart <dn>You</dn> have said, <dq>“Seek <dn>My</dn> face.”</dq> <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> face, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, I seek.
[9] Do not hide <dn>Your</dn> face from me; Do not turn <dn>Your</dn> servant away in displeasure; <dn>You</dn> have been my help; Do not leave me nor forsake me, O <dn>Elohim</dn> of my deliverance.
[10] When my father and my mother have forsaken me, Then <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> does take me in.
[11] Teach me <dn>Your</dn> way, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And lead me in a smooth path, because of my enemies.
[12] Do not give me over To the desire of my adversaries; For false witnesses have risen against me, And they breathe out cruelty to me.
[13] What if I had not believed To see the goodness of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> In the land of the living!
[14] Wait on <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, be strong, And let <dn>Him</dn> strengthen your heart! Wait, I say, on <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>!

readings.title: The Rock of Refuge
readings.subtitle: A Prayer for the People
readings.text:
[Psalm 28:1] I cry to <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my Rock: Do not be deaf to me! For if <dn>You</dn> are silent to me, I shall be like those who go down to the pit.
[2] Hear the voice of my prayers when I cry to <dn>You</dn>, When I lift up my hands Tovard <dn>Your</dn> Set-apart Speaking Place.
[3] Do not draw me away with the wrong And with the workers of wickedness, Who speak peace to their neighbours, But evil is in their hearts.
[4] Give to them according to their deeds, And according to the evil of their practices; Give to them according to the work of their hands; Bring back to them what they deserve.
[5] Because they do not heed the works of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Nor the works of <dn>His</dn> hands, <dn>He</dn> throws them down, And does not build them up.
[6] Blessed be <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Because <dn>He</dn> has heard the voice of my prayers!
[7] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is my strength, and my shield; My heart has trusted in <dn>Him</dn>, and I have been helped; Therefore my heart exults, And with my song I thank <dn>Him</dn>.
[8] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is the strength of <dn>His</dn> people, And <dn>He</dn> is the stronghold of deliverance of <dn>His</dn> anointed.
[9] Save <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> people, and bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> inheritance; And be their Shepherd, and bear them up forever.

readings.title: The Voice Over the Waters
readings.subtitle: Ascribing Esteem to the Creator
readings.text:
[Psalm 29:1] Ascribe to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O you sons of the mighty, Ascribe to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> esteem and strength.
[2] Ascribe to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> the esteem of <dn>His</dn> Name; Bow yourselves to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in the splendour of set-apartness.
[3] The voice of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is over the waters; The <dn>Ěl</dn> of esteem thunders; <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is over many waters.
[4] The voice of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is with power, The voice of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is with greatness.
[5] The voice of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is breaking the cedars, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is breaking <dn>את</dn> the cedars of Leḇanon in pieces.
[6] And <dn>He</dn> makes them skip like a calf, Leḇanon and Siryon like a young wild ox.
[7] The voice of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> cuts through the flames of fire.
[8] The voice of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shakes the wilderness; <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shakes the Wilderness of Qaḏěsh.
[9] The voice of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> makes the deer give birth, And strips the forests bare; And in <dn>His</dn> Hěḵal everyone says, “Esteem!”
[10] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> sat enthroned at the Flood, And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> sits as Sovereign forever.
[11] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> gives strength to <dn>His</dn> people; <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> blesses <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> people with peace.

readings.title: Joy Comes in the Morning
readings.subtitle: A Song at the Dedication of the House
readings.text:
[Psalm 30:1] I exalt <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for <dn>You</dn> have drawn me up, And have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
[2] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn>, I have cried to <dn>You</dn>, And <dn>You</dn> have healed me.
[3] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> brought me up from She’ol; <dn>You</dn> have kept me alive, from going down into the pit.
[4] Sing praise to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, you lovingly-committed ones of <dn>His</dn>, And give thanks at the remembrance of <dn>His</dn> Set-apartness.
[5] For <dn>His</dn> displeasure is for a moment, <dn>His</dn> delight is for life; Weeping might last for the night, But joy comes in the morning.
[6] As for me, I have said in my ease, “Never would I be shaken!”
[7] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, in <dn>Your</dn> good pleasure <dn>You</dn> have made my mountain to stand strong; <dn>You</dn> hid <dn>Your</dn> face, and I was troubled.
[8] I cried out to <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; And to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> I prayed:
[9] “What gain is there in my blood, When I go down to the pit? Would dust praise <dn>You</dn>? Would it declare <dn>Your</dn> truth?
[10] “Hear, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and show me favour; <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, be my helper!”
[11] <dn>You</dn> have turned my mourning into dancing for me; <dn>You</dn> have torn off my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,
[12] So that esteem might praise <dn>You</dn> and not be silent. O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn>, I thank <dn>You</dn> forever.

readings.subsection: Trust in the Midst of Affliction
readings.title: A Rock of Refuge
readings.subtitle: Committing the Spirit to the Creator
readings.text:
[Psalm 31:1] In <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, I have taken refuge; Let me never be ashamed; Deliver me in <dn>Your</dn> righteousness.
[2] Incline <dn>Your</dn> ear to me, Deliver me speedily; Be a rock of refuge to me, A house of defence to save me.
[3] For <dn>You</dn> are my rock and my stronghold; For <dn>Your</dn> Name’s sake lead me and guide me.
[4] Bring me out of the net which they have hidden for me, For <dn>You</dn> are my stronghold.
[5] Into <dn>Your</dn> hand I commit my spirit; <dn>You</dn> have redeemed me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Ěl</dn> of truth.
[6] I have hated those who observe lying vanities; But I trust in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[7] I exult and rejoice in <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment, For <dn>You</dn> have seen <dn>את</dn> my affliction; <dn>You</dn> have known the distresses of my life,
[8] And <dn>You</dn> have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. <dn>You</dn> have set my feet in a large place.
[9] Show me favour, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for I am in distress; My eye, my being and my body have become old with grief!
[10] For my life is consumed in sorrow, And my years in sighing; My strength fails because of my crookedness, And my bones have become old.
[11] I am a reproach among all my adversaries, But most of all among my neighbours, And a dread to my friends; Those who see me outside flee from me.
[12] I have been forgotten like someone dead from the heart; I have been like a missing vessel.
[13] For I hear the evil report of many; Fear is from all around; When they take counsel together against me, They plot to take away my life.

readings.subsection: Trust in the Midst of Affliction
readings.title: My Times Are in Your Hand
readings.subtitle: The Goodness Laid Up for the Trustworthy
readings.text:
[14] But I, I have put my trust in <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; I have said, “<dn>You</dn> are my <dn>Elohim</dn>.”
[15] My times are in <dn>Your</dn> hand; Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, And from those who pursue me.
[16] Make <dn>Your</dn> face shine upon <dn>Your</dn> servant; Save me in <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment.
[17] Do not let me be ashamed, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, For I have called upon <dn>You</dn>; Let the wrong be ashamed; Let them be silenced in She’ol.
[18] Let lips of falsehood be stilled, Which speak recklessly against the righteous, With pride and scorn.
[19] How great is <dn>Your</dn> goodness, Which <dn>You</dn> have laid up for those fearing <dn>You</dn>, Which <dn>You</dn> have prepared for those taking refuge in <dn>You</dn> In the sight of the sons of men!
[20] In the secrecy of <dn>Your</dn> presence <dn>You</dn> shall hide them from the plots of man; <dn>You</dn> shelter them in a booth from the strife of tongues.
[21] Blessed be <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, For <dn>He</dn> has made marvellous <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment to me in a strong city!
[22] And I, I have said in my haste, “I am cut off from before <dn>Your</dn> eyes,” Yet <dn>You</dn> heard the voice of my prayers When I cried out to <dn>You</dn>.
[23] Love <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, all you <dn>His</dn> lovingly-committed ones! For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> guards the trustworthy ones, And exceedingly repays the doer of pride.
[24] Be strong, and let <dn>Him</dn> fortify your heart, All you who are waiting for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: Confession and Covering
readings.subtitle: The Joy of the Forgiven
readings.text:
[Psalm 32:1] Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.
[2] Blessed is the man to whom <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> imputes no crookedness, And in whose spirit there is no deceit.
[3] When I kept silent, my bones became old Through my groaning all the day.
[4] For day and night <dn>Your</dn> hand was heavy upon me; My sap was turned into the droughts of summer. Selah.
[5] I acknowledged my sin to <dn>You</dn>, And my crookedness I did not hide. I have said, “I confess my transgressions to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>,” And <dn>You</dn> forgave the crookedness of my sin. Selah.
[6] Therefore, let every lovingly-committed one pray to <dn>You</dn> While <dn>You</dn> might be found; Even in a flood of great waters They would not reach him.
[7] <dn>You</dn> are my hiding place; <dn>You</dn> preserve me from distress; <dn>You</dn> surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
[8] <dq>“Let <dn>Me</dn> instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; Let <dn>Me</dn> counsel, <dn>My</dn> eye be on you.</dq>
[9] <dq>Do not be like the horse, like the mule, With no understanding, with bit and bridle, Else they do not come near you.”</dq>
[10] Many are the sorrows of the wrong; But as for the one trusting in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Loving-commitment surrounds him.
[11] Be glad in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and exult, you righteous; And shout for joy, all you upright in heart!
